jobs.name: mage
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the WALK CYCLE in this exact approved 2x2 pixel sprite sheet. ONLY modify the two WALK frames: TOP RIGHT and BOTTOM LEFT. Leave TOP LEFT idle and BOTTOM RIGHT happy purchase UNCHANGED. Keep identical framing, scale, head, torso, clothing, viewing direction and background transparency. Adult (25+) stylized game character, no changes to age/design. Both walk frames face LEFT.

The current error: both walk frames seem to step with the SAME leg. Fix with an unmistakable true alternating two-frame stride AND consistent depth shading:
TOP RIGHT WALK 1: the CAMERA-NEAR leg is LIGHTER and stretches FORWARD toward screen LEFT. The CAMERA-FAR leg is distinctly DARKER and stretches BACKWARD toward screen RIGHT, behind the near leg at the hip.
BOTTOM LEFT WALK 2: the DARKER CAMERA-FAR leg now stretches FORWARD toward screen LEFT. The LIGHTER CAMERA-NEAR leg stretches BACKWARD toward screen RIGHT, passing IN FRONT at the hip/thigh overlap. The dark and light legs MUST SWAP their screen-left/right foot positions between frames. NOT merely a different stride width or shifted identical pose. Keep far leg ~35-45% darker than near leg, including thigh, shin and footwear; preserve this identity across both frames. Near leg stays light even when behind in travel direction, far leg stays dark even when forward. No scene lighting change. Clearly separated boot/sandal shapes and contrasting leg silhouettes readable at actual 48x64 pixels. Arms swing OPPOSITE to the near leg when hands are free. Keep head and body at matching coordinates. Keep simple chunky pixel clusters, dark outlines, no smooth rendering. No extra frames, no labels, no guide arrows, no background. Adult female MAGE with messy violet hair, prominent dark circles, large purple hat, belted purple robe, book. Retain all of this unchanged. Adjust only lower robe hem and legs in walking frames so BOTH BOOTS and lower shins are readable. Near boot is medium warm brown with visible golden-brown highlight. Far boot and shin are a distinctly darker muted plum-brown silhouette. Walk1 light boot left/dark boot right; Walk2 dark boot left/light boot right. Near robe fold and leg cross in front of the far leg. Do not remove the long robe or change costume, simply part the hem locally around the stride. Far/near depth shading MUST visibly differ.
